definition_used: A change in the copyright and/or ownership of the article or any of its content.
caution: The definition describes a legal status change (copyright/ownership transfer) without indicating any problem with research content, authorship, peer review, or post-publication oversight. It is a metadata/legal event, not a substantive integrity issue.
semantic_rationale: The definition refers to a change in copyright or ownership, which is a legal rights matter. It does not imply unreliability of research content, authorship/attribution issues, editorial/peer review problems, or post-publication transparency/due process concerns. Therefore, no manuscript category is assigned.
